title: Customer health scoring
transcript:
Consultant: You mentioned churn earlier. How do you spot it coming?
Client: Too late, usually. Someone notices the support tickets piling up.
Consultant: Is there any score today?
Client: No. We want a health score on the account, a number from zero to one
hundred, that our analytics team will write into the CRM every night.
Consultant: So the CRM just stores it, it does not calculate it.
Client: Correct. We calculate it elsewhere and push it in.

expected.note: Numeric field on Account, populated externally.
